name: Backend Frameworks: Node/Django/Spring
description: Building server applications with Express on Node, Django and Spring Boot, then securing, testing and deploying them.

nodes.name: How backends work
nodes.desc: The request lifecycle, routing, middleware and the MVC pattern.
nodes.summary: You will be able to trace an HTTP request through a backend framework's routing, middleware and controllers using the MVC pattern.

nodes.name: API design
nodes.desc: Resource modelling, status codes, errors, versioning and OpenAPI specs.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design backend APIs with clear resources, correct status codes, consistent errors, versioning and an OpenAPI spec.

nodes.name: Data access & ORMs
nodes.desc: Connections, ORMs versus raw SQL, migrations and transactions.
nodes.summary: You will be able to connect a backend to a relational database, choose between an ORM and raw SQL, and manage migrations and transactions.

nodes.name: Express on Node
nodes.desc: Routes, request and response objects and async handlers in Express.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build HTTP endpoints in Express with routes, request and response objects and async handlers.
topics: Creating an Express app and server
Sending JSON responses and status codes

nodes.name: Middleware & errors
nodes.desc: Middleware chains, validation, error handling and logging.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compose Express middleware for validation, logging and centralised error handling.

nodes.name: Databases in Node
nodes.desc: Using an ORM or query builder from Node with migrations.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use a relational database from Node through an ORM or query builder with versioned migrations.

nodes.name: Express API
nodes.desc: Build a validated, documented REST API with Express and a database.
nodes.summary: You will build a validated, documented REST API with Express backed by a database, including errors and tests.
topics: Project structure for an Express API

nodes.name: Django basics
nodes.desc: Projects and apps, URLs, views, templates and settings.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create a Django project with apps, map URLs to views, render templates and configure settings.

nodes.name: Django ORM
nodes.desc: Models, migrations, querysets and avoiding N+1 queries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to define Django models, run migrations, build querysets and avoid N+1 queries with related-object loading.

nodes.name: Django REST APIs
nodes.desc: Serializers, viewsets and permissions with Django REST framework.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build REST APIs in Django REST framework using serializers, viewsets, routers and permissions.

nodes.name: Auth & admin
nodes.desc: Django's user model, authentication and the admin site.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use Django's user model and authentication system and manage data through the admin site.

nodes.name: Spring Boot basics
nodes.desc: Dependency injection, beans, auto-configuration and profiles.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build a Spring Boot application using dependency injection, beans, auto-configuration and profiles.
topics: Inversion of control and dependency injection

nodes.name: Spring MVC & REST
nodes.desc: Controllers, request mapping, validation and exception handling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write REST controllers in Spring MVC with request mapping, validation and global exception handling.
topics: Path variables, params and request bodies

nodes.name: Spring Data JPA
nodes.desc: Entities, repositories, queries and transactions with JPA.
nodes.summary: You will be able to persist entities with Spring Data JPA, write repository queries and manage transactions.

nodes.name: Spring service
nodes.desc: Build a REST service with Spring Boot, JPA and integration tests.
nodes.summary: You will build a REST service with Spring Boot and JPA and verify it with integration tests.
topics: Layered controller, service and repository design

nodes.name: Authentication
nodes.desc: Password hashing, sessions, JWTs, OAuth and role-based access control.
nodes.summary: You will be able to secure a backend with hashed passwords, sessions or JWTs, OAuth sign-in and role-based access control.
topics: Password hashing with bcrypt or Argon2

nodes.name: Background jobs
nodes.desc: Queues, workers, scheduled jobs and retries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to move slow work off the request path with queues, workers, scheduled jobs and safe retries.

nodes.name: Testing backends
nodes.desc: Unit, integration and contract tests for APIs.
nodes.summary: You will be able to test backends with unit, integration and contract tests that run reliably in CI.
topics: Unit tests with mocks and fakes

nodes.name: Deploying backends
nodes.desc: Configuration, containers, health checks and zero-downtime releases.
nodes.summary: You will be able to deploy a backend with environment-based configuration, containers, health checks and zero-downtime releases.

nodes.name: Production API
nodes.desc: Ship an authenticated API with background work, tests and a live deployment.
nodes.summary: You will ship an authenticated API with background jobs, automated tests and a live deployment.
